description: Check the status of any Fold order — works for both hotel-guest pickups and residential pickups. Needs the order code (FOLD-XXXXXX or FHL-XXXXXX) plus the email used when scheduling; with a connected Fold account the email is not needed. Returns current state, a milestone timeline, scheduled dates, items if itemized, and proof-of-delivery photo URL if delivered.

email.description: Email used when scheduling. Not needed when the customer has connected their Fold account.

orderCode.description: Order tracking code like FHL-RRKU92 (hotel) or FOLD-K9ZGQ (residential). Optional when the customer has connected their Fold account: omit it to get their most recent order.

name: track_order
title: Track order
